description: MACRO-style task DAG on maps/t_real.yaml. robot1 carries a kit from A to the station at B and switches the station on (tasks 1->2->3). robot2 fetches a tool at A (task 4, no successors). robot3 has no task (idle support robot). robot1's active task has the longer downstream chain, so MACRO's dag_aware ordering gives robot1 the smaller slack and the priority branch; nothing forces it.
